method: Distinct publisher entity counts restricted to mapped selected records; crashes use group-category membership as a separate check of all-party inclusion.
limitations: Matching counts do not validate all source semantics, true positions, completeness or current conditions.

checks.query: incident_date >= '2025-10-07T00:00:00' AND incident_date < '2026-10-08T00:00:00' AND incident_category in ('Assault','Robbery','Homicide','Rape','Sex Offense') AND report_type_description in ('Initial','Coplogic Initial','Vehicle Initial') AND longitude between -122.52 and -122.35 AND latitude between 37.70 and 37.83

collision_date >= '2024-07-01T00:00:00' AND collision_date < '2026-07-01T00:00:00' AND dph_col_grp_description in ('Vehicle-Pedestrian','Bicycle-Pedestrian','Vehicle-Bicycle-Pedestrian','Pedestrian Only or Pedestrian-Parked Car') AND tb_longitude between -122.52 and -122.35 AND tb_latitude between 37.70 and 37.83
